description.value: Fresh Healthy Café is a nutrition-focused eatery in Gibsons on BC's Sunshine Coast, built around superfood smoothies, cold-pressed juices, acai and pitaya power bowls, and grilled paninis. The café leans heavily on whole-food ingredients and offers a wide range of vegan-friendly and gluten-free choices, making it a standout refuelling stop for health-conscious cyclists. Online ordering with in-store pickup is available, convenient for riders who want food ready on arrival.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for freshgibsons.com is fully accessible and confirms an active healthy café in Gibsons, BC with a robust online ordering system via Square. The site provides clear evidence for takeout (pickup option listed in the shop), and multiple vegetarian, vegan-friendly, and gluten-free items appear throughout the menu. No information about bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging is present anywhere on the site; those fields default to null per the rules.
concerns: OSM name is 'Fresh' but the website consistently uses the full name 'Fresh Healthy Café Gibsons' — may warrant an OSM name update.
No address or phone number present in the OSM record or recoverable from the website front page.
OSM community classification is 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but Gibsons is on the Sunshine Coast mainland, not Vancouver Island.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible healthy café in Gibsons with a live website and online ordering system; a clear refuelling option for touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Veggie Portobello Panini, Veggie Falafel Bowl, Falafel Wrap, Mediterranean Bowl/Wrap, and acai/matcha/pitaya bowls. Website explicitly notes gluten-free bread is available as an option for paninis

wow_evidence: online ordering with in-store pickup is available, convenient for riders who want food ready on arrival
